data.description:
## Context
The Gerrit Verified run for story 0b14 failed in the clean core-wheel optionality lane after PyPI resolved bare `mcp` to newly released 2.0.0. The project MCP extra explicitly supports `mcp>=1.28.1,<2`, and rebar imports `mcp.server.fastmcp`, which MCP 2.0 no longer provides. The workflow currently installs unbounded `pytest jsonschema mcp`, so CI is testing an unsupported dependency major and now fails independently of the patchset.

## Plan
- Change `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` so the lean degradation lane installs MCP using the same supported version interval as `pyproject.toml`.
- Preserve the lane contract: install the core wheel without extras, then add only light test dependencies and supported FastMCP transport; do not install the agents extra.
- Validate workflow YAML/lint and reproduce the lane imports/tests in a clean temporary environment if practical.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The clean core-wheel lane cannot resolve MCP 2.x.
- [ ] The lane still verifies the agents extra is absent.
- [ ] The two MCP optionality contracts execute with supported FastMCP available.
- [ ] Workflow lint passes.
data.title: Pin clean-wheel optionality lane to supported MCP major
